candidates.title: Evacuation order expands for fire burning on west side of B.C.'s Okanagan Lake
candidates.description: Officials have expanded an evacuation order related to an out-of-control wildfire burning on the west side of Okanagan Lake.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: One in 50 million: Oscar the two-coloured lobster lands in N.S. aquarium
candidates.description: In his 40 years as a lobster fisherman, Robert Wagner had never seen a critter like it: a half-blue, half-orange lobster, split down the middle from head to tail. "I said, 'Wow! I've never seen that like that in my life,'" said Wagner. Oscar is now calling the Beaty Centre for Marine Biodiversity in Halifax home.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Wait times for hip and knee replacements in Nova Scotia now shortest on record
candidates.description: Last year, the median wait time in Nova Scotia was 103 days for a hip replacement, down from 173 in 2015, and 129 days for a knee replacement, down from 271 in 2015, according to a June report from the Canadian Institute for Health Information.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: After 8 years and 15,000 kilometres, B.C. couple nears end of Trans Canada Trail trek
candidates.description: A Vancouver Island couple is just a few steps away from completing a journey of over 15,000 kilometres on foot.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Why are some Quebec employers installing heat sensors under work desks?
candidates.description: Some Québecor divisions are installing heat sensors around their offices to make better use of hybrid workspaces. A number of employees say the new technology feels invasive.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Jays trade 3 prospects to land Los Angeles Angels pitcher Jose Soriano
candidates.description: The Toronto Blue Jays have acquired right-handed pitcher Jose Soriano from the Los Angeles Angeles in exchange for infielder Arjun Nimmala, outfielder Eddie Micheletti Jr., and right-handed pitcher Angel Rivero.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Toronto Blue Jays trade Kevin Gausman to Chicago Cubs
candidates.description: The veteran right-hander was traded by the Blue Jays to the Chicago Cubs on Sunday in return for outfielder Brett Bateman and infielder Ty Southisene.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Canada built its nuclear industry to avoid foreign fuel. Its new reactors will depend on it
candidates.description: Canada built its nuclear industry around Candu reactors supplied by a made-in-Canada supply chain. Ontario is building, and other provinces are considering, SMRs that require foreign uranium enrichment and fabrication in an abrupt departure from decades of self-reliance.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'We're all pretty stressed out': Residents in B.C.'s Okanagan flee fast-spreading fire
candidates.description: Residents in B.C.'s north Okanagan region say they had to leave their homes, possessions and in some cases their pets behind to escape a rapidly spreading wildfire near Vernon.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Okanagan Lake wildfire doubles in size as new evacuations ordered across B.C.
candidates.description: At a news conference Sunday, B.C.'s director of wildfire operations, Cliff Chapman, said more than 5,000 people have been evacuated across the province in the past 24 hours.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'Steadfast champion': Sask. senator Todd Lewis dies at 65
candidates.description: Lewis' death was announced in the Senate Saturday afternoon. He's remembered as an advocate for Canadian agriculture and an unwavering voice for rural communities.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: The man who phoned in Canada's most famous UFO sighting became the face of the mystery
candidates.description: The Oct. 4, 1967, Shag Harbour event is considered Canada's most famous UFO incident. Laurie Wickens became the public face of the mystery, a role he kept until his recent death at 76.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Lurkers in the deep: How Canada's new submarines will be used in peace and potential war
candidates.description: The Canadian government has often spoken about the need for submarines to patrol Canada's vast coastline. But the role and range of of its new submarines go far beyond merely patrolling the three coasts of the country.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Iran says no talks underway or meeting plans with U.S. after Trump calls off attacks on Tehran
candidates.description: Iran said on Monday there are no talks underway with the United States and no plans for any meetings, contradicting U.S. President Donald Trump, who had cited talks he said would take place that afternoon as justification for calling off attacks.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Greece battles massive wildfire as hot, dry summer maintains its grip on Europe
candidates.description: A record-breaking hot and dry summer tightened its grip on Europe Monday, as water-dropping planes swooped over a major wildfire in Greece, firefighters in France sought to stabilize a blaze in Provence and much of the U.K. recorded its driest July in nearly two centuries.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: European soccer body UEFA warns FIFA of legal action over Infantino's failed World Cup sell-off plan
candidates.description: European soccer body UEFA has threatened FIFA with legal action over Gianni Infantino's failed plan to sell a stake in future World Cup profits to private investors, and said any potential evidence should not be destroyed.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Rescuers say 5 dead, unknown number of people missing after Indonesian ferry fire
candidates.description: Indonesian rescuers searched for possible missing passengers Monday after rescuing 231 people from a ferry that caught fire the previous day off the main island of Java, leaving at least five people dead. Passengers described leaping overboard and staying afloat for hours before rescue.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: A SpaceX rocket will slam into the moon on Wednesday, and astronomers will be watching closely
candidates.description: In the early hours of Wednesday morning, telescopes around the world will try to capture something never seen from Earth: an old rocket slamming into the moon's daylight side.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Michigan Supreme Court rejects permit for Enbridge oil pipeline under Great Lakes
candidates.description: The Michigan Supreme Court has ordered state regulators to reconsider a key permit that allowed a planned tunnel to carry an oil pipeline under part of the Great Lakes to move forward.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day breaks box-office record for biggest North American opening weekend
candidates.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day broke the Avengers: Endgame record for the biggest North American opening weekend with $360 million US in ticket sales from theatres in the U.S. and Canada, Sony Pictures said Monday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Acting U.S. Attorney General Todd Blanche rescinds 'anti-weaponization' fund
candidates.description: Acting U.S. Attorney General Todd Blanche rescinded an order establishing the "anti-weaponization" fund, paving the way for his confirmation ahead ‌of a key Senate committee vote on Tuesday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: On Ukraine's front lines, female soldiers testing Canadian-designed body armour
candidates.description: Ukrainian soldiers on the front lines of Russia's war are testing new body armour designed by a Canadian company to fit women so that they no longer have to wear ill-fitting ballistic plates made for men.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Destructive wildfires prompt evacuations in Washington state
candidates.description: About 5,000 homes have been evacuated and about 600 homes, businesses and other buildings have been destroyed by wildfires that remained uncontained Sunday in eastern Washington state, authorities said.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Israel says it has 'serious security concerns' over Hamas disarmament deal
candidates.description: Israel has shared "serious security concerns" with the White House regarding the proposed disarmament deal with Hamas, an Israeli official said Sunday in what were some of the first public comments since U.S. President Donald Trump announced the agreement.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 2 killed after helicopters battling Greece wildfires collide
candidates.description: Two Greek firefighting helicopters collided in midair on Sunday as they were battling a wind-driven wildfire west of Athens, sending one aircraft crashing to the ground, footage showed. Two crew members died in the crash.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: EU calls emergency meeting over Ceuta border crisis
candidates.description: The European Union has called an emergency meeting to discuss the crossing of tens of thousands of Moroccan migrants into the Spanish exclave of Ceuta last week. The meeting follows a joint letter from 22 member states calling for action and the need to strengthen EU borders.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Bombing near upscale Moscow restaurant kills 3 people, wounds at least 21
candidates.description: Russian state media, citing local authorities, reported an unidentified woman carrying a homemade bomb tried to get into an upscale restaurant in central Moscow but was stopped by a security guard.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Rhine falls to record low levels as drought strains Europe's rivers
candidates.description: Low water levels in the Rhine, Danube and Po have curtailed the transport of goods and reduced electricity output.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Iran says it is in talks with Oman but not the US after Trump says negotiations to resume
candidates.description: Iran's remarks that there were no talks with the US prompts Donald Trump to issue a strong condemnation of its leadership.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: 'My only son was shot standing up for justice' - inside city gripped by deadly protests in Pakistan-administered Kashmir
candidates.description: The BBC gains unique access to Rawalakot, scene of violent clashes between security forces and protesters in Pakistan-administered Kashmir.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Russian anti-war politician says he has fled the country
candidates.description: Boris Nadezhdin, who was recently designated as a foreign agent, posted a video in front of the Eiffel Tower.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Massive Attack respond after Singapore ban over Palestine display
candidates.description: The UK band says they are "surprised and disappointed" by their treatment over shouting "free Palestine" at a concert there.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Hundreds flee fighting in northern Ethiopia as fears rise of return to civil war
candidates.description: There are concerns of a full-scale conflict once again as a peace deal has not been fully implemented.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Todd Blanche formally withdraws Trump's 'anti-weaponisation' fund plan
candidates.description: Trump's controversial $1.8bn "anti-weaponisation" fund could have been used to compensate people prosecuted over the US Capitol riot.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Two crew killed after firefighting helicopters collide in Greece, as British pilot survives
candidates.description: One Danish and one Greek national died in the incident, while a British pilot and another Greek crew member survived.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: At least 13 killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza after Hamas agree disarmament deal
candidates.description: Israel says it was targeting military operatives in the strikes on Gaza City, Khan Younis and Deir el-Balah.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Solitude as a new aspirational lifestyle: 'We are not lonely'
candidates.description: A growing number of so-called "loneliness influencers" are spotlighting solo living without children or friends - and it's spurring debate.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Ginger hair portraits show unexpected 'golden thread' connecting Americans
candidates.description: For Kieran Dodds, photographing people with red hair has become something of an obsession over the past decade or more.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: At the scene of deadly Moscow bomb blast
candidates.description: Three people have been killed and 21 injured after an explosive device detonated at an Italian restaurant, Russian media reports.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Fastest runner to cross the Alps says it was an incredible experience
candidates.description: Sophie Woods ran the Via Alpina through storms, heat of up to 37C and dodged floods and wildfires across eight countries.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Crowds line Amsterdam's canals for Pride boat parade
candidates.description: Costumed participants danced and waved from a colourful flotilla of 80 decorated vessels as they made their way through the city's waterways.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Injured peregrine reunion 'brought tears to eyes'
candidates.description: The bird of prey was found injured on the ground but was nursed back to health over a month.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Todd Blanche rescinds 'anti-weaponization fund'. And, Trump calls off striking Iran
candidates.description: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche rescinds President Trump's anti-weaponization fund ahead of his confirmation hearing. And, the president calls off strikes on Iran over a potential deal.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Rare photos of ex-Myanmar leader Aung San Suu Kyi give her family hope
candidates.description: Kim Aris, son of Aung San Suu Kyi, told NPR that photographs of his mother meeting a foreign official gave him "a reason to hope" for the first time since the military coup that ousted her in 2021.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: U.S. steps in to help shore up Japanese yen
candidates.description: The U.S. dollar weakened against the Japanese yen Monday after the leaders of both countries confirmed they intervened in the markets to help shore up Japan's currency.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Morocco denies responsibility for events at its border with Spain, as deaths near 100
candidates.description: Four days after tens of thousands of migrants crossed from Morocco into the small Spanish territory of Ceuta, the death toll continues to rise -- nearing 100.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Israel says it has serious concerns with the White House's Hamas disarmament deal
candidates.description: President Trump announced a proposed disarmament deal with Hamas last week. Israeli strikes overnight and into Sunday evening killed at least 17 people, including children, in Gaza.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: South Korea ditches 'denuclearization-first' strategy. What will Pyongyang do next?
candidates.description: South Korea is moving away from its policy of prioritizing the immediate denuclearization of North Korea. But despite that shift, experts doubt Pyongyang will return to the negotiating table.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: U.S. dollar weakens sharply against the Japanese yen after market interventions
candidates.description: The U.S. dollar weakened sharply Monday against the Japanese yen after U.S. President Donald Trump and Japan's finance minister confirmed both sides had intervened in markets.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: A blaze on an Indonesian passenger ferry leaves at least 5 dead and dozens missing
candidates.description: An Indonesian ferry carrying 271 people has caught fire in waters off Madura island, killing at least five people and leaving 41 others unaccounted for, authorities said
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Breakfasts around the world: In Australia, being denied vegemite is grounds for suing
candidates.description: As part of our series on breakfasts from around the world, we take a look at Vegemite, the iconic salty, yeasty spread popular in Australia.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Why is the rate of premature births so high in this community?
candidates.description: About 1 in 4 babies in the Pakistani fishing settlement of Rehri Goth are born prematurely. Researchers are trying to figure out how to bring the numbers down.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: For those with criminal records, AI is breaking down barriers to employment
candidates.description: Tens of millions of Americans have criminal records that can be barriers to employment. An AI-powered app is helping those eligible to expunge their records at a pace not seen before.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Capital One says it closed Trump Organization accounts over money-laundering concerns
candidates.description: The bank is asking a judge to permanently dismiss a lawsuit from Trump-affiliated businesses, arguing a monthslong internal review — not the Jan. 6 riot — explains why hundreds of accounts were shut down in 2021.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: What would it take to get peptides on the shelf?
candidates.description: An FDA advisory panel recently voted to green-light some popular peptides. The decision brought enormous attention to the market for these products — and concerns about the unregulated supply.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Common advice about kid snacking is outdated. Here's what parents should know
candidates.description: Pediatricians recommend kids eat about five times a day: three meals and two snacks. Parents often carry snacks so kids can eat on the go. Here's what science says about snacking.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Trust in public health institutions is eroding. What can officials do?
candidates.description: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe discusses America's declining trust in public health officials with Marianne Udow-Phillips, a lecturer at the School of Public Health at the University of Michigan.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: E-bike injuries are on the rise for children and teens
candidates.description: Doctors are seeing more children injured - some badly - from e-bikes and e-scooters. NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks with Dr. Cornelia Griggs and Caitlin Coit of Mass General Brigham for Children Hospital.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: What Cyclospora does inside the gut and how it gets there
candidates.description: Cyclospora , the parasite that has sickened thousands this summer in the U.S., requires time in the human digestive tract to reproduce.
candidates.author: NPR
